cohort: Cases were women with a first cardiovascular disease (CVD) event between 1991 and 2008 and a previous pregnancy, matched with controls without CVD by year of birth, age, and region of birth.
finding: Pre-eclampsia and gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) are independent risk factors for later cardiovascular disease (CVD), and having both significantly increases this risk, with the association between pre-eclampsia and CVD not being modified by maternal BMI.
